## Purpose

What research question, validation problem, or workflow issue does this change address?

## Change type

- [ ] Data ingestion / cleaning
- [ ] Linkage / matching
- [ ] Denominator construction
- [ ] Validation
- [ ] Analysis
- [ ] Documentation / memo

## Checks

- [ ] Raw data remain untracked
- [ ] Observed and assumed quantities remain clearly separated
- [ ] Existing regression/integrity tests pass where applicable
- [ ] New substantive decisions are recorded in `docs/decisions.md`
- [ ] Reported numbers trace to reproducible outputs
